arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي الِاسْتِقَالَةِ مِِن ذُنوبِهِ و طَلَبِ العَفو
english_title: 16. In Asking Release from sins andSeeking Pardon

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ يَسْتَغِيثُ الْمُذْنِبُونَ،
phrases.english: 1.O God, O He through whose Mercy sinners seek aid!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ إلَى ذِكْرِ إحْسَانِهِ يَفْزَعُ الْمُضْطَرُّونَ،
phrases.english: 2.O He to the remembrance of whose beneficence the distressed flee!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لِخِيفَتِهِ يَنْتَحِبُ الْخَاطِئُونَ،
phrases.english: 3.O He in fear of whom the offenders weep!

phrases.arabic: يَا اُنْسَ كُلِّ مُسْتَوْحِشٍ غَرِيبٍِ،
phrases.english: 4.O Comfort of every lonely stranger!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا فَرَجَ كُلِّ مَكْرُوبٍ كَئِيبٍ،
phrases.english: 5.O Relief of all who are downcast and distressed!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا غَوْثَ كُلِّ مَخْذُوَلٍ فَرِيدٍ،
phrases.english: 6.O Aid of everyone abandoned and alone!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا عَضُدَ كُلِّ مُحْتَاجٍ طَرِيدٍ .
phrases.english: 7.O Support of every needy outcast!

phrases.arabic: أَنْتَ الَّذِي وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء رَحْمَةً وَعِلْماً،
phrases.english: 8.You art He who "embracest everything in mercy and knowledge"! (40:7)

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي جَعَلْتَ لِكُلِّ مَخْلُوق فِي نِعَمِكَ سَهْماً،
phrases.english: 9.You art He who hast appointed for each creature a share of Your favours!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ عَفْوُهُ أَعْلَى مِنْ عِقَابِهِ،
phrases.english: 10.You art He whose pardon is higher than His punishment!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي تَسْعَى رَحْمَتُهُ أَمَامَ غَضَبِهِ،
phrases.english: 11.You art He whose mercy runs before His wrath!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي عَطَآؤُهُ أكْثَرُ مِنْ مَنْعِهِ،
phrases.english: 12.You art He whose bestowal is greater than His withholding!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ اتَّسَعَ الْخَلاَئِقُ كُلُّهُمْ فِي رَحمَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 13.You art He by whose mercy all creatures are embraced!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي لا يَرْغَبُ فِي جَزَاءِ مَنْ أَعْطَاهُ،
phrases.english: 14.You art He who desires no repayment by him upon whom He bestows!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ  الَّذِي لا يُفْرِطُ فِي عِقَابِ مَنْ عَصَاهُ.
phrases.english: 15.You art He who does not overdo the punishment of him who disobeys You!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَا يَا إلهِي عَبْدُكَ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَهُ بِالدُّعاءِ فَقَالَ:
phrases.english: 16.And I, my God, am Your servant whom You commanded to supplicate and who said:

phrases.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، هَا أَنَا ذَا يَا رَبِّ مَطْرُوحٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 17.I am at Your service and disposal! Here am I, my Lord, thrown down before You.

phrases.arabic: أَنَا الَّذِي أَوْقَرَتِ الْخَطَايَا ظَهْرَهُ،
phrases.english: 18.I am he whose back offenses have weighed down!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنا الَّذِي أَفْنَتِ الذُّنُوبُ عُمْرَهُ،
phrases.english: 19.I am he whose lifetime sins have consumed!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَا الَّذِي بِجَهْلِهِ عَصاكَ وَلَمْ تَكُنْ أَهْلاً مِنْهُ لِذَاكَ.
phrases.english: 20.I am he who was disobedient in his ignorance, while You didst not deserve that from him!

phrases.arabic: هَلْ أَنْتَ يَا إلهِي رَاحِمٌ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فَأُبْلِغَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ
phrases.english: 21.Wilt Thou, my God, be merciful toward him who supplicates You, that I should bring my supplication before You?

phrases.arabic: أَمْ أَنْتَ غَافِرٌ لِمَنْ بَكَاكَ فَأُسْرِعَ فِي الْبُكَاءِ
phrases.english: 22.Wilt You forgive him who weeps to You that I should hurry to weep?

phrases.arabic: أَمْ أَنْتَ  مُتَجَاوِزٌ عَمَّنْ عَفَّرَ لَكَ وَجْهَهُ تَذَلُّلاً
phrases.english: 23.Wilt You show forbearance toward him who puts his face in the dust before You in lowliness?

phrases.arabic: أَم أَنْتَ مُغْن مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ فَقْرَهُ تَوَكُّلاً؟
phrases.english: 24.Wilt You free from need him who complains to You of his indigent need with confidence?

phrases.arabic: إلهِي لاَ تُخيِّبْ مَنْ لا يَجدُ مُعْطِياً غَيْرَكَ،
phrases.english: 25.My God, disappoint not him who finds no bestower other than You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَخْذُلْ مَنْ لا يَسْتَغْنِي عَنْكَ بِأَحَدٍ دُونَكَ.
phrases.english: 26.and abandon not him who cannot be freed from his need for You through less than You!

phrases.arabic: إلهِي فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 27.My God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تُعْرِضْ عَنِّي وَقَدْ أَقْبَلْتُ عَلَيْكَ ،
phrases.english: 28.turn not away from me when I have turned my face toward You,

phrases.arabic: وَلا تَحْرِمْنِي وَقَـدْ رَغِبْتُ إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 29.deprive me not when 1 have besought You,

phrases.arabic: وَلا تَجْبَهْنِي بِالرَّدِّ وَقَدْ انْتَصَبْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ.
phrases.english: 30.and slap not my brow with rejection when I have stood before You!

phrases.arabic: أَنْتَ الَّذِي وَصَفْتَ نَفْسَكَ بِالرَّحْمَةِ،
phrases.english: 31.You art He who has described Himself by mercy,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَارْحَمْنِي،
phrases.english: 32.so bless Muhammad and his Household and have mercy upon me!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ نَفْسَكَ بِالعَفْوِ، فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
phrases.english: 33.You art He who has named Himself by pardon so pardon me!

phrases.arabic: قَـدْ تَرَى يَـا إلهِي فَيْضَ دَمْعِي مِنْ خِيفَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 34.You hast seen, my God, the flow of my tears in fear of You,

phrases.arabic: وَوَجِيبَ قَلْبِي مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 35.the throbbing of my heart in dread of You,

phrases.arabic: وَانْتِفَاضَ جَوَارِحِي مِنْ هَيْبَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 36.and the infirmity of my limbs in awe of You.

phrases.arabic: كُلُّ ذَلِكَ حَيآءً مِنِّي لِسُوءِ عَمَلِي،
phrases.english: 37.All this from my shame before You because of my evil works!

phrases.arabic: وَلِذَاكَ خَمَدَ صَوْتِي عَنِ الْجَارِ إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 38.So my voice has become silent, no longer crying to You,

phrases.arabic: وَكَلَّ لِسَانِي عَنْ مُنَاجَاتِكَ
phrases.english: 39.and my tongue has gone dumb, no longer whispering in prayer.

phrases.arabic: يَا إلهِي فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، فَكَم مِنْ عَائِبَةٍ سَتَرْتَهَا عَلَيَّ فَلَم تَفْضَحْنِي،
phrases.english: 40.My God, so to You belongs praise! How many of my flaws You hast covered over without exposing me!

phrases.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ ذنْبِ غَطَّيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْنِي،
phrases.english: 41.How many of my sins You hast cloaked without making me notorious!

phrases.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ شَائِبَة أَلْمَمْتُ بِهَا فَلَمْ تَهْتِكْ عَنِّي سِتْرَهَا،
phrases.english: 42.How many faults I have committed, yet You didst not tear away from me their covering,

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ تُقَلِّدْنِي مَكْرُوهَ شَنَارِهَا،
phrases.english: 43.collar me with their detested disgrace,

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ تُبْدِ سَوْأَتِهَا لِمَنْ يَلْتَمِسُ مَعَايِبِي مِنْ جِيْرَتِي،
phrases.english: 44.or make their dishonour plain to those of my neighbours who search for my defects

phrases.arabic: وَحَسَدَةِ نِعْمَتِكَ عِنْدِي،
phrases.english: 45.and to those who envy Your favour toward me!

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْهَنِي ذَلِكَ  عَنْ أَنْ جَرَيْتُ إلَى سُوءِ مَا عَهِدْتَ مِنّي
phrases.english: 46.But that did not prevent me from passing on to the evil that You knowest from me!

phrases.arabic: فَمَنْ أَجْهَلُ مِنِّي يَا إلهِيْ بِرُشْدِهِ
phrases.english: 47.So who is more ignorant than I, my God, of his own right conduct?

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ أَغْفَلُ مِنِّي عَنْ حَظِّهِ
phrases.english: 48.Who is more heedless than I of his own good fortune?

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ أَبْعَدُ مِنِّي مِنِ اسْتِصْلاَحِ نَفْسِهِ
phrases.english: 49.Who is further than I from seeking to set himself right?

phrases.arabic: حِيْنَ اُنْفِقُ مَا أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
phrases.english: 50.For I spend the provision You deliverest to me

phrases.arabic: فِيمَا نَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهُ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
phrases.english: 51.in the disobedience You hast prohibited to me!

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ أَبْعَدُ غَوْراً فِي الْبَاطِلِ وَأَشَدُّ إقْدَاماً عَلَى السُّوءِ مِنّي
phrases.english: 52.Who sinks more deeply into falsehood and is more intensely audacious in evil than I?

phrases.arabic: حِينَ أَقِفُ بَيْنَ دَعْوَتِكَ وَدَعْوَةِ الشَّيْطَانِ،
phrases.english: 53.For I hesitate between Your call and the call of Satan

phrases.arabic: فَـأتَّبعُ دَعْوَتَهُ عَلَى غَيْرِ عَمىً مِنّي فِيْ مَعْرِفَة بِهِ،
phrases.english: 54.and then follow his call without being blind in my knowledge of him

phrases.arabic: وَلا نِسْيَان مِنْ حِفْظِي لَهُ وَأَنَا حِينَئِذ مُوقِنٌ
phrases.english: 55.or forgetful in my memory of him, while I am certain

phrases.arabic: بِأَنَّ مُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِكَ إلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِهِ إلَى النَّارِ
phrases.english: 56.that Your call takes to the Garden and his call takes to the Fire!

phrases.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَعْجَبَ مَا أَشْهَدُ بِهِ
phrases.english: 57.Glory be to You! How marvellous the witness I bear

phrases.arabic: عَلَى نَفْسِي وَاُعَدِّدُهُ مِنْ مَكْتُوْمِ أَمْرِي،
phrases.english: 58.against my own soul and the enumeration of my own hidden affairs!

phrases.arabic: وَأَعْجَبُ مِنْ  ذلِكَ أَنَاتُكَ عَنِّي
phrases.english: 59.And more marvellous than that is Your lack of haste with me,

phrases.arabic: وَإبْطآؤُكَ عَنْ مُعَاجَلَتِي وَلَيْسَ ذلِكَ
phrases.english: 60.Your slowness in attending to me! That is not because I possess

phrases.arabic: مِنْ كَرَمِي عَلَيْكَ بَلْ تَأَنِّياً مِنْكَ لِي،
phrases.english: 61.honour with You, but because You waitest patiently for me

phrases.arabic: وَتَفَضُّلاً مِنْكَ عَلَيَّ،
phrases.english: 62.and art bountiful toward me

phrases.arabic: لانْ أَرْتَـدِعَ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ الْمُسْخِطَةِ
phrases.english: 63.that I may refrain from disobedience displeasing to You

phrases.arabic: وَاُقْلِعَ عَنْ سَيِّئَـاتِي الْمُخْلِقَةِ .
phrases.english: 64.and abstain from evil deeds that disgrace me,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَِنَّ عَفْوَكَ عَنّي أَحَبُّ إلَيْكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِي،
phrases.english: 65.and because You lovest to pardon me more than to punish!

phrases.arabic: بَلْ أَنَا يَا إلهِي أكْثَرُ ذُنُوباً
phrases.english: 66.But I, my God, am more numerous in sins,

phrases.arabic: وَأَقْبَحُ آثاراً وَأَشْنَعُ أَفْعَالاً
phrases.english: 67.uglier in footsteps, more repulsive in acts,

phrases.arabic: وَأَشَدُّ فِي الْباطِلِ تَهَوُّراً
phrases.english: 68.more reckless in rushing into falsehood,

phrases.arabic: وَأَضْعَفُ عِنْدَ طَاعَتِكَ تَيَقُّظاً،
phrases.english: 69.weaker in awakening to Your obedience,

phrases.arabic: وَأَقَلُّ لِوَعِيْدِكَ انْتِبَاهاً وَارْتِقَاباً
phrases.english: 70.and less attentive and heedful toward Your threats,

phrases.arabic: مِنْ أَنْ أُحْصِيَ لَكَ عُيُوبِي،
phrases.english: 71.than that I could number for You my faults

phrases.arabic: أَوْ أَقْدِرَ عَلَى ذِكْرِ ذُنُوبِي
phrases.english: 72.or have the power to recount my sins.

phrases.arabic: وَإنَّمَا أُوبِّخُ بِهَذا نَفْسِي طَمَعَـاً فِي رَأْفَتِكَ
phrases.english: 73.I only scold my own soul, craving Your gentleness,

phrases.arabic: الَّتِي بِهَـا صَلاَحُ أَمْرِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ،
phrases.english: 74.through which the affairs of sinners are set right,

phrases.arabic: وَرَجَاءً لِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي بِهَا فَكَاكُ رِقَابِ الْخَاطِئِينَ.
phrases.english: 75.and hoping for Your mercy, through which the necks of the offenders are freed.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَهَذِهِ رَقَبَتِي قَدْ أَرَقَّتْهَا الذُّنُوبُ،
phrases.english: 76.O God, this is my neck, enslaved by sins,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَعْتِقْهَا بِعَفْوِكَ،
phrases.english: 77.so bless Muhammad and his Household and release it through Your pardon!

phrases.arabic: وَهَذَا ظَهْرِي قَدْ أَثْقَلَتْهُ الْخَطَايَـا،
phrases.english: 78.This is my back, weighed down by offenses,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَخَفِّفْ عَنْهُ بِمَنِّكَ.
phrases.english: 79.so bless Muhammad and his Household and lighten it through Your kindness!

phrases.arabic: يَا إلهِي لَوْ بَكَيْتُ إلَيْكَ حَتَّى تَسْقُطَ أَشْفَارُ عَيْنَيَّ ،
phrases.english: 80.My God, were I to weep to You until my eyelids drop off,

phrases.arabic: وَانْتَحَبْتُ حَتَّى يَنْقَطِعَ صَوْتِي،
phrases.english: 81.wail until my voice wears out,

phrases.arabic: وَقُمْتُ لَكَ حَتَّى تَتَنَشَّرَ قَدَمَايَ،
phrases.english: 82.stand before You until my feet swell up,

phrases.arabic: وَرَكَعْتُ لَكَ حَتَّى يَنْخَلِعَ صُلْبِي،
phrases.english: 83.bow to You until my backbone is thrown out of joint,

phrases.arabic: وَسَجَدْتُ لَكَ حَتَّى تَتَفَقَّأَ حَدَقَتَايَ،
phrases.english: 84.prostrate to You until my eyeballs fall out,

phrases.arabic: وَأكَلْتُ تُرَابَ الأرْضِ طُولَ عُمْرِي،
phrases.english: 85.eat the dirt of the earth for my whole life,

phrases.arabic: وَشَرِبْتُ مَاءَ الرَّمَادِ آخِرَ دَهْرِي
phrases.english: 86.drink the water of ashes till the end of my days,

phrases.arabic: وَذَكَرْتُكَ فِي خِلاَلِ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَكِلَّ لِسَانِي
phrases.english: 87.mention You through all of that until my tongue fails,

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ أَرْفَعْ طَرْفِي إلَى آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ اسْتِحْيَاءً مِنْكَ
phrases.english: 88.and not lift my glance to the sky's horizons in shame before You,

phrases.arabic: مَا اسْتَوْجَبْتُ بِذَلِكَ مَحْوَ سَيِّئَة وَاحِـدَة مِنْ سَيِّئـاتِي،
phrases.english: 89.yet would I not merit through all of that the erasing of a single one of my evil deeds!

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ كُنْتَ تَغْفِـرُ لِي حِيْنَ أَسْتَوْجِبُ مَغْفِرَتَكَ
phrases.english: 90.Though You forgivest me when I merit Your forgiveness

phrases.arabic: وَتَعْفُو عَنِّي حِينَ أَسْتَحِقُّ عَفْوَكَ
phrases.english: 91.and pardonest me when I deserve Your pardon,

phrases.arabic: فَإنَّ ذَلِكَ غَيْرُ وَاجِب لِيْ بِاسْتِحْقَاق،
phrases.english: 92.yet I have no title to that through what I deserve,

phrases.arabic: وَلا أَنَا أَهْلٌ لَهُ بِـاسْتِيجَاب
phrases.english: 93.nor am I worthy of it through merit,

phrases.arabic: إذْ كَـانَ جَزَائِي مِنْكَ فِي أَوَّلِ مَا عَصَيْتُكَ النَّارَ;
phrases.english: 94.since my repayment from You from the first that I disobeyed You is the Fire!

phrases.arabic: فَإنْ تُعَذِّبْنِي، فَأَنْتَ غَيْرُ ظَالِم لِيْ.
phrases.english: 95.So if You punishest me, You dost me no wrong.

phrases.arabic: إلهِي فَـإذْ قَـدْ تَغَمَّـدْتَنِي بِسِتْـرِكَ فَلَمْ تَفْضَحْنِي
phrases.english: 96.My God, since You hast shielded me with Your covering and not exposed me,

phrases.arabic: وَتَـأَنَّيْتَنِي بِكَـرَمِـكَ فَلَمْ تُعَـاجِلْنِي،
phrases.english: 97.waited patiently for me through Your generosity, and not hurried me to punishment,

phrases.arabic: َو حَلُمْتَ عَنِّي بِتَفَضُّلِكَ فَلَمْ تُغَيِّـرْ نِعْمَتَـكَ عَلَيَّ،
phrases.english: 98.and shown me clemency through Your bounty, and not changed Your favour upon me

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ تُكَـدِّرْ مَعْرُوفَكَ عِنْدِي
phrases.english: 99.or muddied Your kindly acts toward me,

phrases.arabic: فَارْحَمْ طُولَ تَضَرُّعِيْ وَشِـدَّةَ مَسْكَنَتِي وَسُوءَ مَوْقِفِيْ.
phrases.english: 100.have mercy on my drawn out pleading, my intense misery, and my evil situation!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 101.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَقِنِي مِنَ الْمَعَاصِي وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِالطَّاعَةِ،
phrases.english: 102.protect me from acts of disobedience, employ me in obedience,

phrases.arabic: وَارْزُقْنِي حُسْنَ الإِنابَةِ وَطَهِّرْنِي بِالتَّـوْبَةِ،
phrases.english: 103.provide me with excellent turning back [to You], purify me through repentance,

phrases.arabic: وَأَيِّـدْنِي بِالْعِصْمَةِ وَاسْتَصْلِحْنِي بِالْعَافِيَةِ
phrases.english: 104.strengthen me through preservation from sin, set me right through well being,

phrases.arabic: وَأَذِقْنِي حَلاَوَةَ الْمَغْفِـرَةِ،
phrases.english: 105.let me taste the sweetness of forgiveness,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي طَلِيقَ عَفْـوِكَ، وَعَتِيقَ رَحْمَتِكَ
phrases.english: 106.make me the freedman of Your pardon and the slave released by Your mercy,

phrases.arabic: وَاكْتُبْ لِي أَمَاناً مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
phrases.english: 107.and write for me a security from Your displeasure!

phrases.arabic: وَبَشِّرْنِي بِذلِكَ فِي الْعَاجِلِ دُونَ الآجِلِ بُشْرى أَعْرِفُهَا
phrases.english: 108.Give me the good news of that in the immediate, not the deferred - a good news I recognize -

phrases.arabic: وَعَرِّفْنِي فِيهِ عَلاَمَةً أَتَبَيَّنُهَا
phrases.english: 109.and make known to me therein a sign which I may clearly see!

phrases.arabic: إنَّ ذلِكَ لاَ يَضيقُ عَلَيْكَ فِي وُسْعِكَ ،
phrases.english: 110.That will not constrain You in Your plenty,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَتَكَأَّدُكَ فِي قُدْرَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 111.distress You in Your power,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَتَصَعَّدُكَ فِي أناتِكَ ،
phrases.english: 112.ascend beyond Your lack of haste,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَؤودُك فِي جَزِيلِ هِباتِكَ الَّتِي دَلَّتْ عَلَيْهَا آيَاتُكَ
phrases.english: 113.or tire You in Your great gifts, which are pointed to by Your signs.

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ تَفْعَلُ مَا تَشَاءُ وَتَحكُمُ مَا تُرِيدُ،
phrases.english: 114.Verily You dost what You wilt, You decreest what You desirest.

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ.
phrases.english: 115."Thou art powerful over everything". (3:26)
